title: How could we REALLY reach another star? 🚀
description:
Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth on 18 November 2026, after 49 years. At that speed the nearest star would take ~74,000 years. Light sails could cut it to ~20 years, if we can build the lasers.

Sources: EarthSky / NASA on Voyager 1's light-day milestone; Big Think on Voyager's speed and travel times; JAXA on the IKAROS solar sail; Scientific American on Breakthrough Starshot; Caltech on lightsail tests.

claims.claim: Voyager 1 launched 5 Sep 1977, reaches one light-day (~25.9 billion km) on 18 Nov 2026
a signal takes ~24 h each way
Proxima is ~4.2 ly away; ~74,000 years at Voyager's speed
IKAROS (JAXA, 2010) was propelled by sunlight on a sail
Starshot plan: ~100 GW laser array, gram-scale sails, ~20% c, ~20 years to Alpha Centauri; program on hold

speaker: ved
